operations.title: The universal physical-readout quotient kills exactly the jointly invisible commutators and preserves the conditional pi_0 semiring under additive congruence
operations.status: conditional universal theorem with exact finite falsifier
operations.body: For a nonempty family of typed physical-observable representations rho_i of a source group G, let K_obs be their joint kernel and K_phys=[G,G] intersect K_obs. Then G_phys=G/K_phys is the initial quotient killing every jointly invisible commutator, and it is abelian exactly when [G,G] is contained in K_obs. Isotropy-only quotients leave pi_0 unchanged; any additive congruence on the rank-one free additive Carrier automatically respects its endomorphism multiplication, so the conditional initial semiring descends without a Carrier tensor. Flavor locates the quotient after physical readout; cosmology verifies simultaneous pairing but has an already abelian deck group; the D4 orientation line passes non-hostilely while the standard rank-two D4 probe detects the commutator; five-point strings instantiate scalar assembly, but six-point descent is untyped until N_shift tensor Gamma_source -> C is constructed.

operations.title: Grothendieck returns the universal physical-readout congruence theorem and finite falsifier
operations.body: Directed lane complete. For a nonempty family of typed physical-observable representations rho_i, define K_obs=intersection ker(rho_i), K_phys=[G,G] intersect K_obs, and G_phys=G/K_phys. This is the smallest congruence forced to kill every jointly invisible commutator; it is an abelianization iff every commutator is physically invisible. The conditional pi_0 semiring descends without a Carrier tensor: isotropy quotients leave pi_0 unchanged, and every additive congruence on the free rank-one monoid is automatically stable under endomorphism multiplication. Sector typing: flavor is positive only after physical readout; cosmology verifies joint pairing but its deck group is already abelian; the D4 orientation line is an exact but non-hostile rank-one pass; five-point strings instantiate scalar assembly; six-point descent is untyped until N_shift tensor Gamma_source -> C exists. The finite falsifier is a source-established physical observable detecting a commutator; algebraically the standard rank-two D4 probe already detects r^2. Carrier closure and Phase-II gate remain unchanged.
